hook: New workplace laws taking effect this October in 12 states cover pay transparency.

sections.voiceover: New workplace laws taking effect this October in 12 states cover pay transparency.
b_roll: Warning sign flashing over office building

sections.voiceover: Fisher Phillips LLP published an employer cheat sheet on September 18 outlining these rules. Connecticut enforces pay transparency under Sub. HB 5003. Where does Maryland stand on captive audience meetings?
Worse, the District of Columbia introduces critical compliance mandates.
ADP reported that Connecticut employers must disclose wage ranges on October 1. Connecticut employers face new wage disclosure rules on October 1.
